findings.finding: The initial stability wording omitted the upstream major-version condition and traceability selected one out-of-scope constructor.
findings.resolution: Version 1.3.0 documents major > 0 and pre-release semantics, adds stable-zero to the nine-leaf contract, removes the untested constructor from selected_symbols, and adopts the start.md-style task prompt structure.

findings.finding: The instruction examples used getRecords() and try-with-resources without documenting those public contracts.
findings.resolution: Version 1.2.0 documents getRecords(), AutoCloseable/close(), and source-order behavior.
